description: This Kotlin source file defines a Jetpack Compose UI screen called `NewProfileScreen`. It allows users to input profile details such as Profile Name, Host Username, Host IP, Port, and Password. The UI includes styled input fields with borders and rounded corners, a back button, and a save button that persists the profile via `ProfileRepository` and navigates back. The file includes composable functions for the main screen and custom styled input fields.
